prompts.description: Create a developer-focused plan for a Semantic Rails package change.
prompts.name: architect_project_plan

tools.description: Return the recommended Architect MCP workflow and safety guidance.
tools.name: architect_guidance

tools.description: Start a guided project setup dialog, using MCP elicitation when requested and supported.
tools.name: setup_project_dialog

tools.description: Preview or atomically create a strict schema_version: 1 project. DuckDB packages use a two-row starter CSV (data=starter) or read a database another tool builds, such as dbt (data=external); other warehouses need connection_kind, with secrets named by environment variable only.

description.default: Semantic Rails package managed through Architect MCP.
description.title: Description

tools.name: create_project

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Inspect package files and optionally run runtime validation, examples, and package tests.
tools.name: project_status

tools.description: List files inside a Semantic Rails project directory.
tools.name: list_project_files

tools.description: Read a UTF-8 project file by relative path.
tools.name: read_project_file

tools.description: Preview or atomically write a UTF-8 file, rolling back parse failures.
tools.name: write_project_file

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically upsert a model and aligned graph entity. calendar: true makes it the package calendar for calendar_id (default "default", which a package with calendars needs): time.fill reads its date_day time and week_start, month_start, quarter_start and year_start kind: date dimensions. calendar: false reverts that. On a regular model, calendar_id binds its times to a calendar.
tools.name: upsert_model

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically relate two entities: columns on from_entity's model hold to_entity's key, in key order. cardinality: many_to_one or one_to_one.
tools.name: upsert_relationship

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically upsert a curated metric recipe.
tools.name: upsert_metric

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically upsert a segment definition.
tools.name: upsert_segment

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically upsert an example question in examples/<file_name>: spec has query, and optionally question and expected_shape (columns, min_rows, max_rows). The query must validate. spec merges into an existing example.
tools.name: upsert_example

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically upsert a package test in tests/<file_name>. spec.kind is query_returns_columns (query, columns), query_row_count_bounds (query, min_rows and/or max_rows), query_matches_snapshot (query, expected_rows), validate_fails_with_code (query, code), explain_contains (query, text) or metric_equals_query (metric_query, expected_query). Queries must validate; a validate_fails_with_code query must fail with its code. spec merges into an existing test.
tools.name: upsert_test

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Run a semantic query on the package's warehouse, as the query server's execute does, and return at most max_rows rows (1-200), with truncated and total_row_count when there are more. Values are real warehouse data.
tools.name: preview_query

tools.description: Preview or atomically remove a model, dimension, time, measure, metric, segment or relationship (a model's foreign key, keyed by its entity), archiving its YAML. model picks the model when several hold the key. A model takes its entity and relationships along. Refused if a metric would still name it; impact lists the behavior changes and the files still naming a removed id.
tools.name: remove_object

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Preview or atomically move a file into the internal archive.
tools.name: archive_project_file

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: List tables and views (read-only) in a DuckDB package's database or a DuckDB file.
tools.name: list_tables

tools.description: Columns (type, nullability, default) and declared primary, unique and foreign keys.
tools.name: describe_table

tools.description: Per-column counts, min/max and up to 20 samples (sample_limit=0 for none), sampling tables above max_rows (at most one million). Read-only.
tools.name: profile_columns

tools.description: Propose a key, times, dimensions, measures and foreign keys for a relation, with confidences, reasons and draft upsert_model arguments. Read-only.
tools.name: suggest_model

tools.description: suggest_model for each dbt model, from manifest.json and catalog.json (dbt never runs); keys, links and value sets come from dbt tests and contracts. select narrows by model name. Read-only.
tools.name: suggest_models_from_dbt

tools.description: Create or update package models from the selected dbt models in one transaction, writing their foreign keys as entity references. Review with suggest_models_from_dbt first; dry_run=true previews without writing. skipped_models and skipped_references say what was left out.
tools.name: import_dbt_project

outputSchema.description: Stable structured output shared by every Architect mutation tool.
outputSchema.title: ArchitectMutationResult

tools.description: Run parse, runtime, examples, tests, impact, or release validation for a project path.
tools.name: validate_project

tools.description: Diff one project against another path or a git base ref.
tools.name: diff_project

tools.description: Return behavior-change impact, reviewer teams, and risk for a package change.
tools.name: impact_project

tools.description: Run promotion readiness checks for a target package environment.
tools.name: promotion_check

tools.description: Return copy-ready client configuration hints for running Architect MCP.
tools.name: mcp_client_config
